children: on Thursday posted group like-for-like revenue growth of 7% in the 17 weeks to August 29 helped by strong sales in both the UK & Ireland, as well as in the Nordics.

The numbers set an early tone for new CEO Fredrik Tønnesen, and stands out in a UK retail sector where households squeezed by sticky inflation and the economic fallout from the Iran war have reined in discretionary spending.

Like-for-like sales in its main UK & Ireland business rose 6% in the period, boosted by strong sales for cooling products during a summer heatwave and the recent soccer World Cup, while the Nordics division, which accounts for about 40% of group revenue, was up 9%.
